topic: Interest and the time value of money
title: The time value of money
instructions:
## A cedi today is worth more than a cedi next year

Work each question by hand with the formulas, then check with the plotter if you like.

1. GH₵1,000 invested at 10% compounded annually for 3 years.
2. The present value of GH₵5,000 due in 2 years at 8% a year.
3. The effective annual rate of 12% nominal, compounded monthly (as a percentage, two decimals).
4. How many years money takes to double at 7% compound (two decimals).
5. The monthly payment on a GH₵10,000 loan at 1% per month over 12 months.
hints: FV = PV·(1 + r)ⁿ; PV = FV / (1 + r)ⁿ.
Payment = P·r / (1 − (1 + r)⁻ⁿ) with r = 0.01 and n = 12.
